source.what: Validation of the whole chain on real Perseverance Navcam photos with known positions.
source.note: No prior and no truth were given to the engine; the truth is used only for scoring. The matcher is not yet validated (known to be uncalibrated): read these errors as a baseline to rerun after the engine fixes. Samples and residuals left out of this copy (see the full file). OLD TERRAIN: run on the earlier CTX 20 m terrain only, before the HiRISE / CTX mosaic / MOLA-HRSC rebuild; kept as a backup until the run on the new terrain replaces it.
source.label: OLD TERRAIN (CTX 20 m only) · backup run
